interpreterSource.note: Built with ./build-wasm.sh on Linux x86_64 (rust 1.97.1). Testnet only: this is the grammar-7 interpreter with the read-only `check` entry point, deployed so the off-chain builder's simulate and verify can be exercised live. No mainnet deployment, and nothing else deployed was touched.

note: Grammar 7 interpreter, testnet only. The deployer is a throwaway identity funded by friendbot. The pin in packages/policy-synth/src/config.ts names this address.

liveTests.note: An OZ smart account (rule 0: Default, no policy, one delegated signer: the deployer) used by packages/policy-synth's live tests. Rule 1 was installed through buildInstall: an interpreter predicate scoped to a made-up token contract. The recorded RPC fixtures (packages/policy-synth/fixtures/rpc) replay against this account.
